item: Field checks manifest version 3: GHCN-Daily and NSIDC live fetches, early import memory refusal, Windows terminal panel
status: built; each check is the field question itself
summary: R319 release note: Settings -> Advanced -> Diagnostics -> Field checks gains four checks for work merged on 2026-11-08: a live download of one NOAA GHCN-Daily station file through the app's own fetcher and parser (after the network consent popup; nothing stored); the same for both NSIDC sea-ice hemispheres, naming the hemisphere that failed; a read of the app's own run journal for the last three imports (how each ended, each stage's seconds, and how long after the start a memory refusal came; the backup's file name and any other error message are left out), to see whether a big import that cannot fit in memory now stops within minutes; and, on Windows only, whether the terminal panel opens and its keys work, with a local check that the app's Python can import curses. Operator-report checks can now name a local probe, chosen from a list in the code. A field check run request is now limited to 8 inputs and 8192 characters, refused before any check runs.
